$description: Scripted, forgiving replies for the composer and the code pop-up. No live AI. Match by intent, never by exact phrase. Replies use the user's own agent names via {builder}, {reviewer}, {tester}, {teammate}. NEW COPY: none of these replies exist in Figma; Clara should skim and adjust tone.

matching.normalize: lowercase, strip punctuation, collapse whitespace, expand common contractions (don't → do not, what's → what is)
matching.algorithm: Score every intent available in the current context: +2 per keyword hit, +3 per phrase hit, +1 if the intent matches the current milestone's 'expected' intent. Highest score wins; ties go to the expected intent. Score 0 → fallback.
matching.typoTolerance: Treat a word as a keyword hit if its Damerau-Levenshtein distance to the keyword is ≤ 1 for words of 5+ letters.
matching.replyDelay: Show a '{agent} is thinking…' row for 700–1200 ms (random) before the reply, so it feels like an agent.
matching.speaker: Reply as the agent the composer is addressed to. 'To: Team' → the most relevant agent for the intent (fix → builder, why/spec → reviewer, tests → tester), else Bob as 'IBM Bob'.

contexts.build: a builder exists, no issue yet
contexts.issue: issue line exists, sections not all verified
contexts.review: pull request open, waiting on teammate
contexts.ready: a builder exists and is waiting for the user to start the build (ready card showing)
contexts.allClear: every section verified, pull request not opened yet (new)

replies.empty: Add your first collaborator with the + next to your dot. A builder writes code from your spec; a reviewer checks it against the spec.
replies.build: {builder} is working from recurring-investments.yaml. Open {builder} to see its code, or add a reviewer so someone checks the work.
replies.issue: There’s a red line between {builder} and {reviewer}. Click it to see the sections they disagree on.
replies.editor: Click into the code to edit it, then Save. When both agents agree, Verify section unlocks.
replies.review: Your teammates are reviewing the pull request. Reply to each comment; it merges on its own once everyone approves.
replies.done: Everything is merged. Start over from the menu if you want to run it again.
replies.ready: {builder} is ready. Tell it what to build, or click Start from the spec. The approved spec already defines the API.
replies.buildReviewing: {builder} is working from recurring-investments.yaml and {reviewer} is checking it against the spec. Open {builder} to see its code.
replies.recommendation: {reviewer} spotted a gap in test coverage. Add a tester from the suggestion, or choose Not now.
replies.allClear: Every section is verified. Open the pull request from the receipt; the receipt goes with it.

intents.effect: In 'ready': ANY message addressed to the builder or the team starts the build (fires M2), even if no keyword matches; see 'anyMessageStartsBuild'. In 'empty': open the add menu with Builder highlighted. In 'build': acknowledge only.

replies.empty: You’ll need a builder for that. I’ve opened the add menu for you.
replies.ready: Building createPlan, listPlans and updatePlanStatus from the spec.
replies.build: Already on it. I’m generating the controller and DTOs from recurring-investments.yaml.

intents.effect: Open the configure panel for the detected role (default: open the add menu). Never auto-add without the user confirming in the panel.

replies.*: Here’s a {role} to configure. Name it anything you like.

intents.effect: Highlight the 'Accept {reviewer}’s fix' button and preview the fix as a diff. Applying still needs the user’s click.

replies.*: {builder} can add the check before the plan is created and return 409 on a reused key. I’ve previewed it; click Accept {reviewer}’s fix to apply it, or edit the code yourself.

{reviewer} flagged it because the spec says a reused Idempotency-Key returns 409, but the handler never reads the key. {builder} assumed the API gateway handles duplicates, and the gateway isn’t part of this spec.
{reviewer}: The approved spec is the contract, and it doesn’t mention a gateway. If you’re sure, you can Reject this, and the decision is recorded on the receipt with your name.
recurring-investments.yaml v1.2.0 is approved and read-only. createPlan requires an Idempotency-Key header and returns 409 DuplicateRequest when a key is reused.

replies.build: No contract tests yet. A tester could cover the 3 operations in the spec.
replies.*: {tester}: 24 contract tests, all passing once the open issues are resolved.
replies.noTester: There’s no tester in your constellation yet. Add one to cover the 3 operations in the spec.

replies.*: {verified} of {total} sections verified, {issues} open issues. Next: {nextStep}.
replies.ready: {builder} is ready and waiting for your go. Next: {nextStep}.
replies.build: {builder} is building from the spec, with no issues so far. Next: {nextStep}.
replies.allClear: All {total} sections verified, no open issues. Next: {nextStep}.
replies.review: All {total} sections verified. Pull request #482 is waiting on {teammate}.
replies.done: Merged. All {total} sections verified, 7 issues caught before review.

replies.issue: Not yet: {issues} issues are still open on the line between {builder} and {reviewer}. Once every section is verified you can open a pull request.
replies.editor: Not yet: {issues} issues are still open on the line between {builder} and {reviewer}. Once every section is verified you can open a pull request.
replies.review: It merges on its own once every reviewer approves.
replies.*: Open the pull request from the receipt when all lines are clear.
replies.allClear: Every line is clear. Here’s the pull request, drafted from the receipt.
replies.done: It’s merged. #482 went in with the receipt attached.

intents.effect: Open the configure panel for the agent mentioned, focus the NAME field.

replies.*: Sure, change the name here. Everything else will use the new name.
replies.noTarget: There’s no {role} in your constellation yet. Add one with the + and name it anything you like.

intents.effect: Any text sent while the comment is open counts as a reply. After 1.5 s the teammate answers and approves.

replies: Not sure I can help with that one here. {nextStepHint}
That’s outside what I can do in this prototype. {nextStepHint}

nextStepHints.empty: Try adding a builder with the + next to your dot.
nextStepHints.build: Try adding a reviewer so someone checks {builder}’s work.
nextStepHints.issue: Try clicking the red line between {builder} and {reviewer}.
nextStepHints.editor: Try editing the flagged lines, then Save.
nextStepHints.done: You’re all done. Start over from the menu to run it again.
nextStepHints.ready: Tell {builder} what to build, or click Start from the spec.
nextStepHints.allClear: Open the pull request from the receipt.

safety: Stay in character as the agent; don't mention scripts or the prototype unless the fallback says so. Never claim to run real code. Keep replies to 1–3 sentences, plain words, no emoji.

anyMessageStartsBuild.rule: While the ready card is showing, any non-empty message to {builder} or To: Team starts the build. Skip intent scoring EXCEPT for addAgent, rename and spec questions (those keep their own replies and do not start the build). Reply with build.startReply, prefixed by a short echo when the user named a specific operation (e.g. 'Starting with createPlan. ').
